modos.descricao: Pode usar qualquer Gift (Gaia ou Wyrm) se tiver Gnosis

passivas.descricao: Permite usar Gifts de Gaia ou Wyrm (requisito de Gnosis continua valendo)

_metadata.texto_original: The Mage's Talisman allows its user to use any Gifts, whether of Gaia or the Wyrm (the character must still meet the Gnosis requirements of the Gift in Question).
